scene1_screen1.text: The dusk doesn't fall — it leaks, slow and uneasy, into the bones of the street. Windows light up one by one, fragile islands against the thickening gloom. And at the very end of the cul-de-sac, something seems strange.

scene1_screen2.text: In the tangled garden of the old Hart house, the air bends, warping like a glass surface under fire. It hums, low and urgent, like a voice trying to break through.

scene1_screen3.text: Luna Hart stands at the edge of the overgrowth, barefoot on the cold grass. Ash, her usually fearless cat, bolts for the porch without a sound — abandoning her.

scene1_screen4.text: Across the fence, a laugh cracks the tension.

scene1_screen5.text: (grinning) Hi Luna! Long time no see! Are you planning to open a portal to Narnia, or should I start calling the Ghostbusters?

scene1_screen6.text: Luna turns sharply. Her former classmate and also her neighbor Kyle leans on the fence like he belongs there. He’s got that reckless energy about him, all easy smiles and restless hands, but there’s a sharpness in his eyes tonight.

scene1_screen7.text: (quiet, sardonic) Depends. Are you any good with exorcisms?

scene1_screen8.text: Kyle lifts an imaginary badge, all mock authority.

scene1_screen9.text: (confident) Level 20 Paladin! Certified in bad decisions and worse timing.

scene1_screen10.text: The joke stumbles — almost lands. A faint shimmer threads through the dark. Instinctively, they both take half a step closer.

scene1_screen11.text: It isn't just light. It’s breathing...

scene1_choice1.text: How do you respond to the phenomenon?

opts.text: Play it off, keep your distance.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen1.text: Luna exhales, nerves jangling under her skin, and nods toward the shimmer.

scene1_choice1_option1_screen2.text: (low, determined) I feel drawn to explore this phenomenon. How about finding out what it is all about?

scene1_choice1_option1_screen3.text: Kyle vaults the fence with more enthusiasm than sense, landing beside her. Together, they inch toward the distortion, the ground buzzing like a live wire beneath them.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen1.text: Luna forces a shaky laugh, folding her arms tight against herself.

scene1_choice1_option2_screen2.text: (joking) Probably just some weird humidity thing. Like... nature’s version of a fun house mirror!

scene1_choice1_option2_screen3.text: Kyle raises an eyebrow but shrugs easily, though his hand lingers a little too close to the pocket where he keeps his keys, just in case.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen1.text: Luna tightens her grip on her sleeves, heart hammering.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen2.text: (urgent, low) Something’s wrong... We shouldn't be here.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen3.text: Kyle's smile falters, but he nods once, serious now.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen4.text: (soft) Yeah. Not everything broken needs fixing.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen5.text: They step back in unison, shadows swallowing their retreat as the shimmer coils tighter, almost disappointed.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen6.text: (quietly) Or... we go take a closer look. You know, before it grows tentacles and starts charging rent.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen7.text: Luna shoots him a look — part disbelief, part exasperated smile.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen9.text: (grinning) Worked better than “let’s go back inside and pretend we didn’t see cosmic fabric tearing in your backyard.”

scene1_choice1_option3_screen10.text: She hesitates, her fingers still curled into her sleeves. Then, with a breath that sounds too much like surrender, she nods once.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen11.text: (sighing) If something pulls us into another dimension… I’m blaming you first.

scene1_choice1_option3_screen12.text: (smiling, soft) Fair trade. I’ll make sure we land somewhere interesting.

scene1_screen12.text: Behind them, the night deepens — but the ripple remains, a fracture stitched into the world, is pulsing with every beat of their hearts.

scene1_screen13.text: Whatever just woke up… It's not going back to sleep easily.

scene1_screen14.text: They move together — not out of trust, but because instinct says it’s worse to face this alone.

scene2_screen1.text: The garden, the fence, the neat suburban rows — all dissolve, swallowed by something older, heavier.

scene2_screen2.text: Above, the sky twists, bruised and broken, as if clawed from the inside out.

scene2_screen3.text: (murmuring, half-joking) Pretty sure this isn’t just a blackout anymore.

scene2_screen4.text: At the roots of the dying tree, the shimmer spasms — wild, frantic. They come from the amulet lying there.

scene2_screen5.text: Luna approaches the roots and takes the amulet in her hands. It bursts into white flame. She gasps, clutching it tighter - but it is too late.

scene2_screen6.text: Her can Ash cries out from the porch — a sound more human than feline — and the ground cracks beneath them.

scene2_screen8.text: The world is torn apart and Luna and Kyle pass into another world through the rift.

scene2_screen9.text: The trees loom crooked and skeletal, the air thick with iron and rain. The ground pulses underfoot, as if breathing.

scene2_screen10.text: (hoarse, scanning) Where the hell are we?

scene2_screen11.text: Luna stumbles. The amulet slips from her hand, dissolving into mist midair. Without thinking, Kyle catches her by the waist, steadying her as she sways. For a moment, they are close — too close.

scene2_screen12.text: Her hair lifts in a breeze he can’t feel. Her skin gleams faintly, like the first light of a hidden moon. And when she lifts her face, her eyes — not just Luna’s eyes anymore … These are the eyes of the entity.

scene2_screen13.text: (voice layered, deep) I am speaking to you, an ancient prophet, you can call me Oracle!

scene2_screen14.text: The portal gave me the opportunity to come to you. The gates have thinned. The veil has torn. Under the root and the river, the lost ones wake.

scene2_screen15.text: Kyle jerks back slightly, breath catching. Luna moves forward without seeing, her bare feet leaving no mark on the ground. She raises a hand — and where her fingers pass, the mist peels back like curtains.

scene2_screen16.text: The Forgotten Realm. A mirror world, cracked by broken vows. Built on promises never kept, and dreams never mourned.

scene2_screen17.text: You both were marked. Long before you knew. It was never just about you. You were chosen — again.

scene2_screen18.text: From the mist, a glowing path unfurls — floating stones, a rift ahead pulsing like a heartbeat.

scene2_screen19.text: (quiet, shaken) This is real, isn’t it?

scene2_screen20.text: The gate waits. So does the cost. Choose your tether. Choose your strength.

scene2_screen21.text: She extends her hand — glowing, steady. The portal breathes in response.

scene2_screen22.text: (half to himself) And here I thought this was just going to be a weird night.

scene2_screen23.text: Luna jerked and her eyes returned to normal.

scene2_screen24.text: What the hell happened to me!? I thought I was talking, but I couldn't control what I was saying! I felt like I was in double space!

scene2_screen25.text: Oh, trust me, you're not the only one who's shocked. It seems there's an entity within you that asks to be called the Oracle, and you chose to accompany me on this adventure!

scene2_screen26.text: Oracle? Like an ancient fortune teller?

scene2_screen27.text: I think so, but maybe we can talk about that later? It seems like this portal wants something from us.

scene2_choice1.text: How do you answer the call?

scene2_choice1_option1_screen1.text: Kyle moves slowly, afraid that one wrong move could shatter this fragile, impossible thing between them. He threads his fingers through hers, gentle but sure.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen3.text: So would you, if a portal were judging your soul.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen4.text: (soft grin) Maybe. But I’d still reach for you.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen6.text: Because you’re the only thing that’s felt real all night. Even with that magic act.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen7.text: He offers his hand. No pressure, no drama — just there.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen9.text: We do it together. I also feel like I should be with you tonight... like I have a destiny to be with you.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen10.text: She takes his hand. Fingers tighten. The glow ignites between their palms, warm and alive.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen12.text: I’m not letting go. Not this time.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen13.text: The portal widens — not with power, but with trust.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen1.text: (smirking) You’re glowing, the ground’s humming, and reality just tore open.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen2.text: (wry) You really commit to the bit, huh?

scene2_choice1_option2_screen3.text: (grinning) Yep. And I say we walk straight into it.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen4.text: Before she can stop him, he steps out fast, confident.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen6.text: (over his shoulder) Hesitation’s how people die in horror movies.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen7.text: The portal pulses — not angry. More like… intrigued.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen1.text: Luna, it seems he is thirsty for us! I promise I will not abandon you in this adventure!

scene2_choice1_option3_screen2.text: He just stays beside her, grounding her, like gravity in human form.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen3.text: So you trust me even though I'm some kind of damn Oracle?

scene2_choice1_option3_screen4.text: I don’t need to see the end to know who I’m walking with. I also feel like I should be with you tonight... like I have a destiny to be with you..

scene2_screen28.text: She breathes out slowly, nods, and moves. He matches her step for step. Together, without another word, they step into the unknown.

scene2_screen29.text: As the portal seals behind them, the world shifts again — carrying them deeper into the realm where memory and magic intertwine.

scene3_screen1.text: The world reforms around them, slow and dense like rising smoke. The air is thick with the scent of burnt sage, old parchment, and something older — the weight of memory. Or fate.

scene3_screen2.text: Inside the tent sits a woman — Luna, but not Luna. Beside her stands a man — Kyle, only... older. In the way they move, in the way they see each other, everything feels heartbreakingly known.

scene3_screen3.text: The present Luna and Kyle hover in the doorway, unseen observers — and yet every heartbeat, every flicker of candlelight feels intimately, painfully real — as if their souls remember.

scene3_screen4.text: They’re not just witnessing the past. They are stepping into a pattern they’ve walked before.

scene3_screen5.text: (whispered, intense) The stars shift. The river bends. Tonight, the veil thins... and I must see beyond.

scene3_screen6.text: You'll not stand alone. Not while breath remains in me. I will always be your protector, as you are our light, our oracle.

scene3_screen7.text: The Oracle reaches forward, her fingers trembling with the weight of fate. The man before her — her protector — kneels without hesitation.

scene3_screen8.text: Present Luna feels the ache of it in her bones — not just longing, but recognition. Something ancient stirs, something that’s waited. The present Kyle watches too, breathless, recognizing in the stranger's loyalty a reflection of what stirs unspoken inside himself.

scene3_screen9.text: (voice soft, breaking) Desire fuels sight. The heart’s fire burns the mist clean. But passion demands a price.

scene3_screen10.text: (quiet) Then let it take me. If it means you’ll see clearly.

scene3_screen11.text: The tent tightens around them, shadows pressing inward. The air crackles with a tension older than memory — the echo of a bond reforged across lifetimes.

scene3_screen12.text: Drawn by something stronger than reason, Present Luna and Kyle feel it stir — the unmistakable pull of souls that meet each other again and again, across centuries.

scene3_screen13.text: They see it clearly now: she has always been the Oracle. He, the one who kneels — loyal through fire, time, and death.

scene3_screen14.text: The weight of lives they lived, lost, and loved rushes between them. Desire rises — not sudden, but inevitable, not born in this moment, but remembered from all the moments they’ve already lived, and all they’re fated to live in the future.

scene3_choice1.text: How do you respond to the pull between you?

opts.text: Bond, but hold the space between.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen1.text: Present Luna moves forward, as if caught in a current too strong to resist. Kyle watches her approach with eyes full of unspoken promises.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen2.text: (voice low, raw) No matter the life, I always end up at you. Somehow, some way.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen3.text: She lifts trembling fingers to his jaw, tracing the familiar line of him. His breath catches — and in that space, that aching heartbeat — she closes the distance.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen4.text: Their mouths meet, tentative at first, then fiercer, hungrier — as if they’ve been waiting across a hundred lifetimes for this moment.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen5.text: In the fire behind her eyes, visions bloom: two figures chasing each other across ages, across worlds — dying, finding, loving, losing, and finding again.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen6.text: At the center of every life: this kiss. This bond. This choice — made again, across time.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen1.text: Present Luna reaches out, linking her fingers with his. Their hands fit together like forgotten prayers — soft, sure, steady.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen2.text: (soft, unbreakable) I'd stand with you against the end of everything. And still ask for more time.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen3.text: She presses their joined hands to her heart, as if anchoring him there — steady, eternal.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen4.text: The visions flicker: all the battles fought together, victories whispered under breath, laughter shared in stolen corners of broken worlds. A loyalty so deep it rewrites their destiny.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen1.text: Present Luna lifts her hand, almost touching — then lets it hover near his heart without closing the distance.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen2.text: Her eyes meet his, not in regret, but in fierce understanding.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen3.text: (soft) Some fires are meant to smolder. Not consume.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen4.text: Kyle's answering nod is slow, reverent. The space between them hums — potent, waiting.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen5.text: Visions bloom of quiet companionship, trust tested by years, laughter that survived every ending.

scene3_screen15.text: They stand once more in the strange half-world — the Forgotten Realm — side by side. Their fingers brush — tentative, questioning.

scene3_screen16.text: A truth burns under their skin: They are not really strangers. They are not strangers. They never were. Not in this life. Not in any.

scene3_screen17.text: The past world leaves them, dissolving, and they again find themselves in their present, albeit changed, world.

scene4_screen1.text: The mist snaps away like a torn sheet. Rain pours instantly, cold and sharp, soaking them to the bone.

scene4_screen2.text: The portal they woke pulses nearby, louder now, splitting the earth, silver mist leaking like blood from a gash.

scene4_screen5.text: No…  Yes.  I don’t know. It’s like I can still feel them — the lives we lived. Like they’re still inside me, screaming to be remembered.

scene4_screen6.text: (soft) Then we don’t ignore it. Tell me what to do.

scene4_screen7.text: The ground groans beneath them — ancient, pained. From the heart of the portal, something stirs — dark, slow, rising.

scene4_screen8.text: I’m the Oracle, Kyle. I don’t get to run. I feel it — this obligation to close the portal before it swallows the world.

scene4_screen9.text: And I’m not letting you face it alone. This thing — it affects me too. I meant what I said: I’ll protect you. I’ll help you.

scene4_screen10.text: You didn’t choose this... You still can turn back.

scene4_screen11.text: (slowly, firmly) No, Luna. You were born for this — I chose it!

scene4_screen12.text: She stares at him — wet hair plastered to her face, heart thudding, breath caught between fear and something dangerously close to love.

scene4_screen13.text: I don’t understand. Why would you stay?

scene4_screen14.text: Because if I have to fight for any world… I want it to be the one you exist in. I should’ve told you long ago — I’ve always looked out for you.

scene4_screen15.text: (smiling) You know, even after everything tonight… that still sounds strange.

scene4_screen16.text: She laughs — soft, unexpected. Kyle rubs the back of his neck, sheepish.

scene4_screen17.text: Although when we were at school and studied together, only you believed that I could sense what tests would be on the test.

scene4_screen18.text: I never thought that you were guessing. I knew you sensed something that others couldn’t.

scene4_screen19.text: Something clicks into place — not a memory, but a truth they’ve always known. Souls drawn across lives. Trust that began long before tonight. Together, they were ready for whatever the portal might bring.

scene4_screen20.text: For a moment, everything goes quiet. Even the rain feels softer. And in the space between them, soaked, shaking, something fierce and unspoken blooms.

scene4_choice1.text: How do you answer the moment?

opts.text: Be her partner — fight by her side.
You have doubts about everything that happens.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen1.text: Kyle doesn’t hesitate. The world may be tearing open in front of them, but all he sees is her: shaking, drenched, standing between fate and ruin.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen2.text: He grabs her wrist and pulls her into him, one arm wrapping around her waist, the other cradling the back of her head.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen3.text: She gasps — not from fear, but from the way he holds her. Not like she’s the weapon. Not the storm. But the answer.  The thing he’s been reaching for across lifetimes.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen4.text: You don’t even know what I am...

scene4_choice1_option1_screen5.text: I know exactly what you are.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen6.text: (eyes wide) And you still want me?

scene4_choice1_option1_screen7.text: More than anything I’ve ever wanted.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen8.text: His forehead rests against hers, rain dripping from his lashes, his breath mixing with hers — fast, warm, ragged. The crackle of magic around them rises — not in warning, but in rhythm.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen9.text: And then he kisses her. A kiss full of fear, fury and longing — the kind that says: if we die here, I’m dying with your name in my mouth.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen10.text: She clutches his shirt, anchoring herself to him. They lose themselves in the moment — against the roar of the portal, against the crumbling world.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen11.text: The shadow shudders, the portal shrieks — and Luna feels her magic ignite.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen12.text: She pulls back, breathless, lips tingling.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen13.text: It’s time. Before it’s too late.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen14.text: He doesn’t speak. He just takes her hand — and together, burning with rain and light, they face what waits beyond.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen1.text: Kyle steps up beside her, shoulder brushing hers — a quiet gesture, steady and grounding.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen2.text: Side by side. As in every life before this one.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen3.text: He pulls out the keys he always jokes about carrying "just in case" — attached is a small blade gleaming silver in the stormlight.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen4.text: Luna feels the ground firm under her feet, as if the world itself steadies at the sight of them standing together.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen1.text: For a moment, Kyle freezes. Too much, too fast — magic, prophecy, lifetimes crashing onto his shoulders. Luna faces the portal alone, her body trembling as she tries to contain it.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen2.text: But when the portal lashes out — a whip of mist cutting through the air — Kyle moves without thinking. He barrels into her, knocking her out of the way just in time.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen4.text: Together, they crash into the wet grass, breathless but alive. The portal flickers, just enough for Luna to regain her focus.

scene4_screen21.text: The storm deepens, but the shadow flinches, screaming into the night. Luna's eyes begin to change…

scene4_screen22.text: Only the power of two hearts, their interweaving, can close the portal and save this world.

scene4_screen23.text: Honestly? I have no idea what I’m supposed to do anymore!

scene4_screen24.text: Luna’s body, no longer entirely her own, reaches toward Kyle — hands radiant, trembling. He grasps them instinctively.

scene4_screen25.text: I’m letting go of your Luna soon. You must guide her. Tell her to listen to her heart — the words are already there. Words you both have always known.

scene4_screen26.text: The portal collapses in on itself with a shriek like a dying star. The mist folds inward. The ground stills. And silence — deep, shaking silence — falls.

scene4_screen27.text: For a long moment, neither of them moves. The rain slows to a whisper against their skin. Only one ritual is strong enough to seal the veil between worlds.

scene4_screen28.text: But the ritual demands two. Neither of them will walk it alone.

scene5_screen1.text: Luna’s eyes return to normal. She slowly frees her hands from Kyle’s, blinking as if waking from a deep dream.

scene5_screen2.text: Well, it seems like someone has become themselves again. I have a message for you from your Oracle self.

scene5_screen3.text: Let me guess… I was glowing and cryptic again? I feel drained. And… different.

scene5_screen4.text: She said you’ll need to remember something — special words that will help us save the world. Any ideas?

scene5_screen5.text: Luna is confused. Kyle watches her, waiting, but the moment passes unanswered.

scene5_screen6.text: Alright. We’ll figure it out. No pressure.

scene5_screen7.text: Actually…I feel a pull. Into the forest. Like something’s calling me.

scene5_screen8.text: Just then, Ash — her black cat — bolts past them, letting out a sharp meow.

scene5_screen9.text: Wait, Ash, where are you going!?

scene5_screen10.text: Ash darts into the trees beyond the garden.

scene5_screen11.text: What if this is a sign? Is that where you are drawn?

scene5_screen13.text: Two people — a modern oracle and her protector — follow the call of fate into the woods.

scene5_screen14.text: They push past the final thicket, where silver mist clings low to the ground. In the clearing ahead stands an ancient stone altar.

scene5_screen15.text: Ash perches on the altar, poised and still, as if he had been waiting all along. His green eyes shimmer with eerie intelligence.

scene5_screen16.text: Luna steps forward. Faint letters — etched into stone and nearly swallowed by time — glow softly: "Through the joining of souls, the world heals. Through the oath of hearts, the rift seals."

scene5_screen19.text: This power… it doesn’t belong to anything written in the stars. It’s ours now.

scene5_screen20.text: Kyle stands beside her, close enough to feel her breath. He says nothing more — just waits.

scene5_screen21.text: You’re not going to tell me what to do?

scene5_screen22.text: No. I think you already know.

scene5_screen23.text: The symbols on the altar pulse once, then fade — as if the world itself is holding its breath, waiting for her choice.

scene5_choice1.text: How do you seal the worlds?

scene5_choice1_option1_screen1.text: Luna reaches for Kyle’s hand, threading her fingers through his. Their palms fit together like puzzle pieces finally aligned. Together, they raise their joined hands above the altar.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen2.text: I think as we walked I began to guess what words I needed to remember. Do you recall the play we acted in — the one where the children sealed the dark world?

scene5_choice1_option1_screen3.text: Oh, those lines that seemed to make no sense? About the gates to another world?

scene5_choice1_option1_screen4.text: Yes, that's it. We'll say it together — line by line. I'll start.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen5.text: I vow to stand at the gate.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen6.text: To guard what must be guarded!

scene5_choice1_option1_screen7.text: To trust, even when the night is longest.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen8.text: I vow to shield the flame.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen9.text: To hold the line when all else falls.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen10.text: To meet you again — even if the world forgets our names.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen11.text: The altar bursts with light — warm, blinding, pure. The clearing glows like the heart of the sun.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen1.text: Luna steps close to Kyle, her heartbeat louder than the storm they left behind. Her soul remembers the thousand times she reached for him — in fire, in silence, in exile — and the thousand times he came.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen2.text: She closes the last breath of distance between them, her fingers brushing along the side of his face, tracing the stubble along his jawline. He leans into her touch instinctively, his breath catching.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen3.text: They said the world needed words. But maybe it only ever needed this.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen4.text: She leans in — not gently, but with the gravity of fate. Their lips meet, not like a question, but like an answer echoing through lifetimes.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen5.text: He answers with his whole body — hand in her hair, the other anchoring her against him, breath tangled in hers.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen6.text: The world around them melts. The altar pulses brightly, the silver veins across the ground flaring with their combined magic. Ash leaps down silently from the altar’s surface, tail flicking as he circles them once — a guardian approving the union.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen7.text: Their lips meet — and it’s not just a kiss. It’s a memory, a reunion, a promise reborn in heat and silence.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen8.text: Not losing you. Not this time.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen9.text: She pulls him closer, fingers fisting in his shirt, matching his urgency, his need — steadying herself against the rhythm of his heartbeat.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen10.text: Then don’t stop. Not until it’s sealed.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen11.text: The air crackles. Magic erupts around them — not from spells, but from touch, from trust, from the way they fit like they’ve always known how.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen12.text: Every time I look at you, I feel that I know you by heart, across silence and centuries.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen13.text: Light spills from their joined bodies, golden and alive. The mist spins, then bursts — a thousand glittering sparks showering around them like stars falling in reverse.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen14.text: No matter where we begin, I’ll end up at your side.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen16.text: Around them, the altar glows — not blinding, but steady, sacred. The rift mends with a final, quiet breath. Just them. Choosing each other — again.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen1.text: Luna says nothing. She simply reaches out and takes Kyle’s hand in hers — no hesitation. Their fingers entwine naturally, like something they’ve done a thousand times before.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen2.text: He doesn’t speak either. He only squeezes her hand in return — gentle, grounding. Their eyes meet. In that stillness, something vast moves between them.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen3.text: (whisper) We remember. We return. We remain.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen4.text: The altar pulses — a slow, steady glow. Ash sits at its base, tail curled around his paws, eyes glowing green.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen5.text: (quietly) Even if the world forgets us…We won’t forget who we are.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen6.text: Only two hands, joined. And the magic that hums between them like a thread stretched across centuries.

scene5_choice1_option3_screen7.text: The portal folds inward with a soft exhale. The mist settles. The world mends — not with light, but with knowing.

scene5_screen24.text: The altar glows no more — only its memory lingers, warm in the earth beneath their feet. Above them, the sky opens. Stars hang in new constellations — unfamiliar, yet somehow deeply known.

scene5_screen25.text: Ash purrs softly, tail curling like ink in water. He pads past them into the trees, as if his task is done.

scene5_screen26.text: Luna exhales shakily, the weight of magic receding but not vanishing. Kyle stands beside her — steady now, no longer dazed. Not just her protector. Her partner. Her equal.

scene5_screen27.text: And despite everything unknown ahead, despite the darkness yet to come, there is a certainty now: they are no longer strangers tangled in fate. They are something stronger. They defeated the rift of worlds.

scene6_screen1.text: Luna and Kyle stand in the clearing, surrounded by the hush of a world saved. Above them, strange constellations shimmer back into familiar patterns.

scene6_screen2.text: So... do all your first dates end with saving existence?

scene6_screen3.text: (laughing softly) You’re assuming this was a date?

scene6_screen4.text: Hey, I’m pretty sure nearly dying together counts for at least coffee!

scene6_screen5.text: Their laughter slips into the night — quiet, real, a little shaky. They’re both changed, and they know it.

scene6_screen6.text: You’re not just the witch next door, are you?

scene6_screen7.text: No. I don't think I ever was.

scene6_screen8.text: And I’m not just the guy with terrible lawn care habits who sometimes looks after his neighbor.

scene6_screen9.text: They smile — not wide, but knowing. Behind them, a new portal flickers… then fades. Not needed. Not tonight.

scene6_screen12.text: No. I’m offering you my famous pancakes! Tomorrow morning. But only if you promise not to ask what’s in them.

scene6_screen13.text: Deal. But I want syrup! And answers.

scene6_screen14.text: They walk back through the trees, side by side, steps slow but steady. They don’t look back.

scene6_screen15.text: The world is quiet now. Morning’s waiting — and after that… who knows? Talk to your partner and discuss what happens next.
